COMMUNICATIONS PREFERENCES

This page explains the kinds of messages Zoorzio sends you and how to control them.

SERVICE MESSAGES

These are the reminders, briefings, and replies you've asked Zoorzio to send through WhatsApp, Telegram, email, or the app — the core of how the product works. Because they're essential to the Service, you can't opt out of these while keeping your account active, but you're always in control of what you ask Zoorzio to remember and remind you about.

ACCOUNT AND BILLING EMAILS

We'll email you about things like plan changes, upcoming renewals, payment receipts, and security notices (for example, a new device signing in). These are also considered essential and can't be turned off, since they keep you informed about your account.

PRODUCT AND MARKETING EMAILS

From time to time we may email you about new features, tips for getting more out of Zoorzio, or occasional offers. These are optional. You can unsubscribe using the link at the bottom of any marketing email, or by emailing contact@zoorzio.com with "unsubscribe" in the subject line — we'll process it within a few business days.

CHANNEL-SPECIFIC SETTINGS

If you've connected Zoorzio to WhatsApp or Telegram, you can mute or leave that conversation at any time using the controls in that app, independent of your Zoorzio account settings.

HOW WE USE YOUR CONTACT INFORMATION

We only use your phone number, email address, and connected channels to deliver the communications described on this page. See our Privacy and Security Policy for how we handle and protect that information.

CONTACT US

Questions about what you're receiving from us? Email contact@zoorzio.com.
